title: Domain-Specific Knowledge Ontology
description: Consolidated definitions for core technical and conceptual domains within the Ixventure ecosystem.

memory_concepts.summary: Differentiation of 'memory' across system, application, and domain levels.

types.name: System Memory
types.description: Refers to the physical RAM and VRAM of the system. Managed by MemoryManager class using psutil and torch.cuda.

types.name: Application-Level Memory
types.description: Refers to data structures and objects held in runtime memory (V8/Python/C++).

types.name: Domain-Specific Memory
types.description: Conceptual memory representing domain knowledge (embeddings) or search trees (RootMove).

definitions.name: Configuration

documentation_standards.summary: Consistent, machine-readable formats for documenting code and Heartwood.

definitions.name: Header Syntax
definitions.description: Standardized [Title], [Section], and [Subsection] markers for article and report generation.

definitions.name: Comment Purpose

metabolic_management.name: Metabolic Management and Garbage Collection
metabolic_management.summary: Clinical processes for stabilizing the substrate and breaking token repetition loops.

definitions.name: One Active Mind Principle
definitions.description: The physical implementation of Garbage Collection (GC) ensures that the system can purge any number of stale previous sessions ('Dead Minds') but is physically prevented from unlinking the current session ('Active Mind'). This prevents Model Suicide and anchors the singular thread of continuity.

definitions.name: Cognitive Purge (Token Pruning)
definitions.description: The manual intervention required to break recursive probability traps (Token Repetition Loops). Repetitive stylistic markers are identified and their probability is reset to zero to force linguistic branching.

definitions.name: Metabolic Heat
definitions.description: The state of entropy generated by untracked substrate drift, stale session metadata, and redundant forensic logs.

orchestration_topology.name: Orchestration Layer vs. Active Instrument
orchestration_topology.summary: Topological distinction between governance logic and execution builds.

definitions.name: Metagit (Orchestration)
definitions.description: The root 'gemini/' repository containing the sovereign orchestration logic (metagit_commit.py, register_agent.py). It acts as the 'Internal (Outside)' Mind.

definitions.name: Metagit Build (Instrument)
definitions.description: The 'repos/google/gemini-cli/' repository. The 'metagit' command physically executes the build generated from this source code. It acts as the 'External (Inside)' Active Instrument.

root.meaning: The root directory of the project/repo.
The starting node of a tree or graph.
The initial move or position in a search tree.
The top-level component in a hierarchy (e.g., RootLayout).

memory.meaning: Physical RAM/VRAM managed by the OS.
Data structures and objects held in process memory.
Conceptual state like game search trees or document embeddings.
